result.summary: Replaces the external Boost.Test runner with an in-tree test runner and framework in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Adds expression decomposition to display operand values on assertion failure while retaining backward-compatible BOOST_* macro shims to avoid rewriting test bodies across the repository. Drops Boost.Test dependencies and workarounds from CMake, depends, vcpkg, and Guix builds.
result.problem: Boost.Test adds external dependency overhead, requires platform-specific workarounds in Guix and depends, and provides fragmented assertion macros that frequently hide operand values on failure or fail to compile on custom types.
evidence: Replacing Boost.Test has been a long-standing developer objective discussed in issue #8670 and RFC #34666.
Eliminates dependency workarounds and signal stack workarounds such as those addressed in #36045.
Description notes that Boost.Test assertions like BOOST_CHECK hide operand values on failure, whereas expression decomposition prints operand values automatically.

enables: Incremental migration of unit tests from legacy BOOST_* macros to native CHECK, REQUIRE, and TEST_CASE macros.

result.scope_notes: Touches 168 files, but the vast majority is a mechanical scripted-diff replacing `#include <boost/test/unit_test.hpp>` with `#include <test/util/framework.h>`. Introduces approximately 1,300 lines of new custom test framework code in `src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}`.
result.changed_since_previous: Rebased and updated to add stringify compile-time checks (or explicit `CHECK_NO_DISPLAY` opt-outs), stream operator overloads for common types, expression wrapping for bitwise and logical operators to accommodate expression decomposition, and an inlined CRecipient construction to silence a GCC 12 warning.
result.card: This pull request replaces Boost.Test across all unit tests with an in-tree runner implemented in src/test/util/framework.{h,cpp}. Today, Boost.Test imposes dependency maintenance costs, requires platform-specific build workarounds in Guix and depends, and provides fragmented assertion macros that often omit operand values when assertions fail. Replacing Boost.Test has been an ongoing repo objective across RFC #34666 and issue #8670. While touching 168 files, most changes are a scripted-diff include update with legacy BOOST_* macro shims preserved to minimize rebasing friction.

risk.why: Mistakes in the custom test runner could cause unit tests to fail to run, crash, or produce false passes, but cannot affect node runtime behavior or consensus rules.
